limitations: Marked PnL changes with the venue mark and remains provisional until each lifecycle closes.
Exit-now and stop estimates exclude future funding and execution slippage.
The summed stop estimate is not a guaranteed loss ceiling and is not a joint probability model.
A simultaneous gap through both venue-native stops can produce a worse result than the estimate.
falsifiers: Any contributing open lifecycle lacks an exact actual entry fill, owned protective stop, bound exit plan, or reconciled marked economics.
The aggregate differs from the sum of its exact lifecycle rows.
The continuous artifact generator source hash differs from the loaded source.
The report claims execution authority, an actual exit fill, a loss ceiling, or a joint probability.
